sttServer.title: Speech recognition server
sttServer.intro: What you say is recognised on a server: the sound is sent there and the text comes back. With no servers of your own the public OpenVoiceOS servers are used.
sttServer.urls: Your own servers, one address per line
sttServer.urls.hint: The whole address, such as https://stt.example.org/stt. Leave empty to use the public servers.
sttServer.verify.hint: Only turn this off for a server you test with.
